 │ ▸ Sign in to Candle      │ │  This machine has 3 Candle profiles and none is selected. Which should the Candle     │ 
 │                          │ │  Harness use?                                                                         │ 
 │ · Connect your agent     │ │                                                                                       │ 
 │                          │ │  ▸ production    Wall…1111                                      api.alpha.candle.tv   │ 
 │ · Wallet and limits      │ │    desk          Wall…2222                                      api.alpha.candle.tv   │ 
 │                          │ │    old                                                                                │ 
 │ · The tour               │ │    Sign in a new profile                                                              │ 
 │                          │ │                                                                                       │ 
 │ · Where to start         │ │  A new profile becomes the CLI's active one, since none is selected now. The CLI's    │ 
 │                          │ │  other profiles stay as they are.                                                     │ 
 │                          │ │                                                                                       │ 
 │                          │ │  The Candle Harness records the profile it uses and acts as it on every step, so      │ 
 │                          │ │  switching the CLI's active profile later never moves your agents to another          │ 
 │                          │ │  account. It never reads another profile's keys.                                      │ 
 │                          │ │                                                                                       │ 
 │                          │ │                                                                                       │ 
 │                          │ │                                                                                       │ 
 │                          │ │                                                                                       │ 
 │ about 5 minutes          │ │                                                                                       │ 
 │ quit any time: it picks  │ │                                                                                       │ 
 │ up where you stopped     │ │                                                                                       │
